title: Goal S1. Full-bleed Geometry and Shared Surface Runtime
summary: Independent audit rejected the first S1 candidate; the bounded pipeline/container correction is in progress.
done_when: Landing full-bleed geometry and inner alignment are proven in a browser.
One typed Surface container exposes only bounded presentation and local decorative media options.
Atlas, schemas and capability-owned nesting reject invalid paths, children, count, order and depth before render.
Full, single and preview share the accepted production path and deterministic evidence.
Hero output remains byte-identical and S2 remains unstarted.
